0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Vyell appears to be in a state of annoyed bewilderment.

48.original: I'm terribly sorry to bother you, but might I ask a small favor? I just saw the gleaner I'd hired for a job, and he seemed awfully...well, “jittery,” I suppose is the word.

49.original: And when I tried to ask him what the matter was, he met my eyes for a moment then bolted out of the room...

50.original: I should like to catalog the items he was meant to bring and get them safely stored, but I refuse to play this ridiculous game of coeurl and mouse.

51.original: Would you mind tracking him down for me? The last I saw of him, he was dashing off towards Passemerrant Pasturponics.

52.original: Most curious behavior for a gleaner. I do hope he's not unwell...

53.original: This large pot is clearly of Far Eastern origin.

54.original: Gah! Gods and scholars, don't sneak up on me like that! Can I help you...?

55.original: Ah, my employer sent you, did he? Well, he'll be pleased to know that I was able to purchase all his requested Far Eastern items of cultural significance.

56.original: That pot there was one of them, but I was leery of simply handing it over. I think...I think there's something <hex:021A020203>alive<hex:021A020103> inside...

57.original: (-Voice from the Pot-)You tell me where this is, yes, yes?

58.original: There! You heard that, didn't you!? I <hex:021A020203>knew<hex:021A020103> it wasn't my imagination!

59.original: You seem a well-traveled sort─what sort of creature might we be dealing with here?

62.original: The sort you shouldn't keep trapped in pots.

63.original: One which will feed the whole family!

64.original: (-Voice from the Pot-)Oho, you know your Namazu, yes, yes! I crawled into this comfy looking pot for a nice nap, and before I knew it, I was whisked away on an adventure!

65.original: (-Voice from the Pot-)Wait! Before you spill me out, would you mind pouring in a generous splash of water? I couldn't bear for anyone to see me so dried out, no, no!

66.original: (-Voice from the Pot-)Oho, very funny. You are one of those who like to make jests in a serious tone of voice. It...<hex:021A020203>was<hex:021A020103> a jest, yes, yes?

67.original: (-Voice from the Pot-)Well, now that I'm here, I might as well make the most of my misfortune! See the sights, try the food, that sort of thing... Convey my pot to the nearest inn, if you please!

68.original: Seeing as our, uh, “guest” is so eager to stay, the least I can do is sponsor his visit and help fill out the paperwork. Meanwhile, I would appreciate it if you could explain the situation to my employer.

69.original: (-Voice from the Pot-)When I closed my eyes, I did not expect to wake up in a different country, no, no!

70.original: This may be the oddest thing that has ever happened to me...but please be assured that I will take good care of our unwitting traveler.

71.original: Did you catch up with the gleaner? What did he have to say for himself?

72.original: ...Are you telling me that Namazu are real!? By the Scholar, I thought the stories of such beings were just that─stories.

73.original: And now we have the chance to speak with one in the flesh! We really must house this visitor here in the Archeion, and record the conversations for posterity!

74.original: ...Hm? Oh, yes, here, you've been very helpful. Now, if you don't mind, I have preparations to make!
